topic: Which came first? 4 pairs of Telugu hits (same star in each pair)

slides.sub: 4 pairs of Telugu hits. Both films in each pair share a star. Pick A or B before you swipe!

slides.te: Vijay కి first lead role ఇదే!
slides.en: Pelli Choopulu (Jul 2016) came before Arjun Reddy (Aug 2017). It also won the National Award for Best Feature Film in Telugu.

slides.label: Q2 • MEDIUM
slides.question_en: Both: Jr NTR + director S. S. Rajamouli.

slides.te: Rajamouli కి director గా first సినిమా!
slides.en: Student No: 1 (Sep 2001) came before Simhadri (Jul 2003). It was S. S. Rajamouli's first film as a director.

slides.te: Trisha కి ఇదే first Telugu release!
slides.en: Varsham (Jan 2004, Sankranti) came before Chatrapathi (Sep 2005). It was also Trisha's first Telugu release.

slides.label: Q4 • HARDEST
slides.question_en: Both star Nagarjuna, and both released in the same year.

slides.en: Geethanjali (May 1989) came before Shiva (Oct 1989). Geethanjali was Mani Ratnam's first Telugu film; Shiva was Ram Gopal Varma's first film as director.
